Chess opening names: the lichess-org/chess-openings data set (https://github.com/lichess-org/chess-openings),
files a.tsv to e.tsv (columns: eco, name, pgn), unchanged.

License: CC0 1.0 Public Domain Dedication (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/).
"As a collection of facts, this data set is in the public domain."

scripts/build_openings.py turns these into site/data/openings.json for the website.
